caseName: RIDGWAY NATIONAL BANK Et Al. v. PENNSYLVANIA
caseNameFull: Ridgway National Bank v. State of Pennsylvania
attorneys: William, I. Crosby and B. R. Cop-polo for appellants., Anne X. Alpern, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, John Sullivan, Deputy Attorney General, and Robert C. Derrick, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
